translationRepairs: On dinghai An Congjin of Shazhou moved to Yanzhou.

Chinese 陝州 is Shanzhou (陕州), not Shazhou (沙州); the idiomatic English confuses the two prefectures. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.
On dinghai Shazhou military commissioner An Congjin was transferred to garrison Yan prefecture.
On dinghai Shanzhou military commissioner An Congjin was transferred to garrison Yan prefecture.
Chinese 陝州 is Shanzhou, not Shazhou; the literal English repeats the same prefecture error. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.
On xinchou Prince Li Congrong was made palatial chamberlain with three-honour parity and concurrent secretariat director.
On xinchou Li Congrong, Prince of Qin, was granted the honor of Open Office with Rank Equal to the Three Excellencies and concurrently appointed Director of the Secretariat.
The proposed correction is substantively warranted by the Chinese, but the replacement needed clearer, more complete English and consistent title terminology.
After pacifying Shu Mingzong had Li Gao write and carve the 《Five Classics》 at the Directorate of Education—the start of its printing.
After pacifying Shu Mingzong had Li E write and carve the 《Five Classics》 at the Directorate of Education—the start of its printing.
Chinese 李鍔 is Li E (鍔), not Li Gao; the idiomatic English mistranslates the given name. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.

When Later Tang pacified Shu, Mingzong ordered Grand Academy doctorate Li Gao to write the 《Five Classics》, copying their production, carving blocks at the Directorate of Education—this was the Directorate's beginning of carved books.

When Later Tang pacified Shu, Mingzong ordered Grand Academy doctorate Li E to write the 《Five Classics》, copying their production, carving blocks at the Directorate of Education—this was the Directorate's beginning of carved books.
Chinese 李鍔 is Li E, not Li Gao; the literal English repeats the given-name error. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.

On jimao Suo Zitong of Hezhong became Fuzhou commissioner.
Chinese 河中 is Hezhong, not Hedong (河東), and 鄜州 is Fuzhou, not Bozhou (亳州). The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.

On jimao former Hezhong military commissioner Suo Zitong was made Fuzhou military commissioner.
Chinese 河中 is Hezhong and 鄜州 is Fuzhou; the literal English repeats both place errors. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.

Chinese 丙申 is bingshen, not bingchen; the literal English repeats the day-name error. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.

Chinese 鄜州 is Fuzhou, not Bozhou. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.

On gengzi former Fuzhou military commissioner Sun Zhang died—court suspended.
Chinese 鄜州 is Fuzhou, not Bozhou; the literal English repeats the prefecture error. The cited Chinese directly supports the proposed correction.
